name: Quantity Take-off Export
description: Read-only quantity take-off from a saved snapshot: counts, lengths, areas and volumes per category and type, written as CSV and BC3 (FIEBDC-3) files in the workspace.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to measure. Required when connected to Revit.

categories.description: Only these categories, for example OST_Walls.

snapshot_units.description: Units of the Length, Area and Volume values in the snapshot. Output is always m, m2 and m3.

bc3_measure.description: Quantity that becomes the BC3 measurement of each type. auto picks one per category.

max_rows.description: Rows and listed elements returned in the result; the files always hold everything.

csv_filename.description: Optional .csv file name inside the workspace. A second file <name>_no_quantity.csv lists elements without a quantity.

bc3_filename.description: Optional .bc3 file name inside the workspace (FIEBDC-3, ANSI, no prices).
